function.description: Use when you need to preview a CSV file, confirm column names, or inspect example rows before choosing a computation tool.
function.name: read_csv

max_rows.description: Maximum number of preview rows to return.

path.description: Relative path to a CSV file. Examples: 'csv/member.csv', 'data/train.csv'. Paths are relative to the task context directory; DO NOT prepend 'context/'. For example use 'knowledge.md' or 'csv/foo.csv', not 'context/knowledge.md'.
